files.rationale: Section 40: the code veil. z-index 1 with pointer-events none, section containers lifted to z-index 2, so the layer cannot cover text or take a click. Ink comes from a variable the script sets per band, after mix-blend-mode: overlay proved invisible against a near-white ground.

Builds the veil from eight invented SQL and Python snippets, moves its mask with the pointer through the existing rAF-throttled handler, and picks the ink from the --primary-color of the band under the cursor. Also splits the effects gate: interactive() for visitor-facing effects everywhere, enabled() adding the canvas's on-screen condition. That split fixes a TASK-012 regression that killed the cursor ring below the hero.
Cache-busting version only. The veil is built by script, so no markup changed.
Next free section is 41, and the no-decoration-above-text rule plus the invented-code rule are stated where someone editing CSS will read them.
INV-STYLE-005 makes the stacking guarantee a contract rather than an implementation detail, so a future overlay has to prove it the same way.
Records the split gate and the TASK-012 regression it corrects.
The task, including the two requirements with no executed evidence.
